chronology.notes: Chron uses the surface date (0 BP) and 5 radiocarbon dates.

geochron.geochronnotes: Water depth (550 cm) is subtracted from the sample depths as per Whitlock (1993, Table 2). Water depth is not subtracted from the dates reported in Radiocarbon, however.

site.sitedescription: Kettle lake. Physiography: stagnation moraine, Hedrick Pond Advance. Surrounding vegetation: open forest, Pinus contorta, Pseudotsuga.
